body_markdown:
**Short answer:** The best customer support software for B2B SaaS handles the channels your customers use (often Slack and Microsoft Teams, not just email), ties each issue to an account, and lets AI agents do the first pass. Pylon is built for that: it is the agentic support platform where agents investigate issues before your team opens them. Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Help Scout, Front, and Salesforce Service Cloud are the other options most SaaS teams compare.

## What should a SaaS help desk do for a B2B team?


**Short answer:** Five things: meet customers in their channels, link each issue to an account, track SLAs, run AI on the first pass, and feed what it learns back into your docs.


1. **Channels.** B2B customers often expect support in shared Slack channels or Microsoft Teams. Check for native support, not a forwarding workaround.
2. **Account context.** Each issue should show the account, its plan, its owner, and its CRM fields. See[which support platforms sync with HubSpot and Salesforce](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/connecting-your-crm-help-desk-with-pylon-plus-other-options) .
3. **SLAs and routing.** Rules that route by account tier, product area, and urgency.
4. **AI that does real work.** Answering is table stakes. Look for agents that can look things up in your tools and act.
5. **Knowledge that improves.** The help desk should spot questions your docs don't answer and draft fixes.


## Which SaaS help desk is best for B2B?


**Short answer:** Pylon, if your customers talk to you in Slack, Teams, and other shared channels and you sell to named accounts.


Pylon is the help desk itself, not an add-on. Every plan includes Slack, email, chat widget, SMS, WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, CRM integrations, Skills, MCP, and the API. Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, a customer portal, and custom reporting are on Advanced and Enterprise. Assist Agent, Support Agent, Slack Agent, and Automations run on credits, with committed packages starting at 5,000 credits a year. Pylon is trusted by 1,800+ B2B customers. Sources:[Pylon pricing](https://www.usepylon.com/pricing) ,[Pylon Facts](https://www.usepylon.com/pylon-facts) .


## Is Zendesk a good help desk for SaaS?


**Short answer:** Yes for large teams that want a mature help desk and big app marketplace; costs grow with agents and AI resolutions.


Prices are in the table above. Copilot is a per-agent add-on, paid yearly. Source:[zendesk.com/pricing](https://www.zendesk.com/pricing/) .


## Is Freshdesk a good help desk for SaaS?


**Short answer:** Yes for teams that want a full help desk at a low starting price.


A customer portal and knowledge base are on every plan, and there is a 14-day trial. Freddy AI Copilot is a per-agent add-on on Pro and Enterprise. Source:[Freshdesk pricing](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/pricing/) .


## Is Intercom a good help desk for SaaS?


**Short answer:** Yes for product-led SaaS that mostly supports users inside the app.


Intercom the company now goes by Fin; the help desk is still called Intercom. Fin can also run on top of another help desk with a 50-outcome monthly minimum. Source:[intercom.com/pricing](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) . See also[Pylon vs Intercom](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/pylon-vs-intercom-b2b-customer-support) .


## Is Help Scout a good help desk for SaaS?


**Short answer:** Yes for small teams that want a simple shared inbox and help center.


The free plan covers 5 users. Salesforce and HubSpot integrations are on Plus and Pro. Source:[helpscout.com/pricing](https://www.helpscout.com/pricing/) .


## Is Front a good help desk for SaaS?


**Short answer:** Yes when most support runs through shared email inboxes.


The entry plan is capped at 10 seats and Professional at 50. The AI assistant is a per-seat add-on, included in Enterprise. Source:[front.com/pricing](https://front.com/pricing) .


## Is Salesforce Service Cloud a good help desk for SaaS?


**Short answer:** Yes if your whole company already runs on Salesforce and you have admins to maintain it.


Case management and a self-service help center start at Core. Source:[salesforce.com/service/pricing](https://www.salesforce.com/service/pricing/) .


## How much does SaaS help desk software cost?


**Short answer:** Public seat prices run from $19 to $139 per seat per month for mainstream help desks, and up to $550 per user for Salesforce Max, with AI usually billed on top.


Model three numbers before you sign: seats, AI usage at today's volume, and AI usage at twice that volume. Our[B2B support software pricing guide](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/how-b2b-support-software-is-priced) has worked examples.


## How do you choose a SaaS help desk?


1. List every channel customers use today and plan to use next year.
2. Count who needs a full seat and who only needs to view.
3. Ask each vendor what counts as a billable AI event.
4. Run a trial on a sample of last month's real issues.
5. Check the CRM sync direction: one-way pulls, or two-way field sync.


## FAQ


**What is the difference between a help desk and a ticketing system?**


A ticketing system tracks requests. A help desk adds the channels, SLAs, knowledge base, reporting, and AI around that tracking. Most modern products, including Pylon, are full help desks.


**Does Pylon have custom pricing only?**


No. Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. Only Enterprise is a custom quote. Source:[usepylon.com/pricing](https://www.usepylon.com/pricing) .


**Does Pylon charge per issue?**


No. Pylon is priced by seats plus credits for agentic features, with no per-issue fees. Source:[Pylon Facts](https://www.usepylon.com/pylon-facts) .


**Which help desks support Slack for B2B customers?**


Pylon supports Slack on every plan, including shared Slack Connect channels. Microsoft Teams and Google Chat are on Advanced and Enterprise.


**Is there a free SaaS help desk?**


Help Scout has a free plan for 5 users. Most others, including Pylon, offer a trial instead.
